title: A Frog's Tongue Strikes in 0.07 Seconds, 5x Faster Than a Blink

scenes.text: A frog's tongue hits in 0.07 seconds.
That's five times faster than you can blink.
The tongue is as soft as brain tissue, ten times softer than yours.
Its spit is thicker than honey, but when the tongue whips out, it turns watery.
The bug gets pulled in at up to 12 times gravity.
A tongue softer than a brain, faster than a blink. Watch it again.

description:
A frog's tongue hits its target in under 0.07 seconds, five times faster than a human blink.
Georgia Tech researchers found the tongue is about as soft as brain tissue and the spit changes from thick to watery on impact.
Could you catch a fly that fast?
first_comment: Which animal do you think is the fastest hunter?
